title: Glace Franui
creator: les_recettes_de_joanna
steps: Blend the raspberries and sieve out the seeds.
Heat the water and powdered sugar in a pan until syrupy, then mix into the raspberry purée.
Pour into moulds, insert sticks and freeze 5 hours.
Unmould. Dip each ice lolly first in melted white chocolate (in a tall glass), then in melted milk chocolate.
Set on baking paper and keep in the freezer.
notes: Most of the chocolate is for dipping; you'll have some left over.
